page.overview:
What is Q'yth-az?

Q'yth-az (also known as The Crystalloid Intellect) is a fictional entity in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Scott David Aniolowski for his short story "An Early Frost", and was later incorporated into Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. (: Ye Booke of Monstres)

Q'yth-Az is a Great Old One that lives on a lightless world known as Mthura. It's a stationary entity that extends and absorbs with frost-like tentacles. Anything living that is touched by the crystalline tendrils is transformed into formations of solid minerals. By generating large clusters of sharp, heavy minerals and crystals it crushes victims.

It is able to project its thoughts and influences across the cosmos via mineral formations. Humans that are psychically sensitive who come into contact with crystal formations can pick up its projected thoughts, its influence often manifesting in dreams.
